items.title: Trump’s Tariff Refund Saved Lowe’s From An Earnings Miss. Here’s The Math On How Government Tariff Refunds Are Padding Retailers’ Profits
items.summary: Lowe's cleared Wall Street's bar last quarter, but one line in the release tells a different story. Court-ordered tariff refunds are flowing to retailers, not shoppers, and each company is spending the windfall differently.

items.title: Ross Stores Earnings Beat But Tepid Holiday Outlook Sinks Stock
items.summary: Ross Stores earnings and sales jumped above views, but Q4 guidance underwhelmed.

items.title: CFOs On the Move: Week ending Nov. 20
items.summary: PayPal names Xero’s CFO as its next finance chief, The Home Depot promotes its CFO to CEO and Citgo hires a LyondellBasell exec as chief financial officer.

items.title: Filings Show Trump Sold MCD and HD and Bought SpaceX Stock Instead
items.summary: A multimillion-dollar selloff in two household-name stocks and a much smaller bet on the year's biggest IPO make for a provocative filing. The White House has an explanation, and the details in the 751-transaction report test how well it holds up.

items.title: 343 Companies Report $28.5 Billion In Trump Tariff Refunds. Here's Where The Money Is Going.
items.summary: Major U.S. companies are recording billions in tariff recoveries following a Supreme Court ruling, with some reducing business costs and others returning payments to customers.

items.summary: The $22.83 billion fund bought $172.9 million of stock and sold nothing, lifting all 47 positions.

items.summary: The $39.09 billion fund bought $720.1 million of stock on Wednesday, with $496.0 million net bought across 56 increased positions.
